title: api: schema versioning v2 deprecations + beta headers + backcompat shims for OpenAI-compat
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Motivation: stabilize streaming semantics, formalize request/response schema versioning, and provide a smooth migration path for OpenAI-compatible clients. This PR introduces schema version v2 opt-in via a beta header, deprecates a few legacy fields, and implements backcompat shims so existing integrations continue to work while teams migrate. Summary of changes: - Add X-Redwood-API-Version header support (values: v1, v2, beta-v2). - Deprecate legacy 'model_version' query param and legacy top-level 'choices' shape in favor of namespaced 'response' envelope. - Add backcompat shim that rewrites legacy incoming payloads to v2 internal shape and emits deprecation warnings to audit logs and response headers. - Stabilize streaming framing for structured output and function/tool-calling payloads; fix a race in the chunking logic that caused reorder on slow connections. - Update OpenAI-compat layer to translate between OpenAI-style requests and internal v2 shapes, with opt-in beta header for v2 strict semantics. Checklist: - [x] implement header parsing and routing - [x] add backcompat shim middleware - [x] update OpenAI-compat translation layer - [x] add unit and integration tests for streaming and structured output - [x] update docs and migration guide - [x] telemetry for deprecation usages Migration notes: clients that do nothing will continue to work for now because of the shims, but will receive deprecation headers and audit log entries. To opt-in to v2 semantics (strict structured output, function calling normalization, and new streaming frames) include header X-Redwood-API-Version: beta-v2 or v2. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and gating (ENG-4567, ENG-4981). Backwards compatibility: shim preserves token-level streaming and preserves function-calling metadata; special-cased normalization applied only when header absent. Impact: no immediate breaking change for hosted API; Dedicated/Private customers will be notified with a 90-day sunset on legacy fields once telemetry thresholds are met. Links: Docs migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/api-schema-v2-migration Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4567 Schedule: staged rollout to internal canaries on 2026-02-22, public beta 2026-02-25. Merge method: squash.
